items.description: From the Longhorns to the Dawgs, a bunch of top teams bottomed out in Week 7.

items.headline: Hawaii visits Northern Illinois in MWC action
items.description: Hawaii (1-6) at Northern Illinois (0-6), Oct. 24 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Tyler Hughes totals 379 yards on offense and Wyoming dumps Northern Illinois 41-23
items.description: — Tyler Hughes compiled 379 yards of total offense and scored four rushing touchdowns to lead Wyoming's 41-23 victory over Northern Illinois on Saturday.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 6: Texas takes major fall
items.description: There's no mercy for Texas: One loss and the Longhorns land on our dubious list.

items.headline: Air Force does not complete a pass, beats Northern Illinois in the Huskies' first Mountain West game
items.description: — Evan Medders and Owen Allen combined for more than 200 yards rushing and four scores for Air Force, and the Falcons beat Northern Illinois 28-7 on Saturday night in the Mountain West Conference inaugural for the Huskies.
